selected_branches.branch: Parking in a designated and posted curb-adjacent fire lane

law_text: No person shall stop, stand or park a vehicle except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device, in any of the following places: At any place or in any space adjacent to a curb which has been designated and posted as a fire lane pursuant to the City's Fire Code, whether the vehicle is attended or unattended and whether the location is on public or private property.

topic_inventory.exact-text: No person shall stop, stand or park a vehicle except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device, in any of the following places: At any place or in any space adjacent to a curb which has been designated and posted as a fire lane pursuant to the City's Fire Code, whether the vehicle is attended or unattended and whether the location is on public or private property.

runtime_uncertainties: Physical sign visibility and actual parking completion require later CARLA run and original recording review.
City Fire Code designation and posting source must be verified for each actual location; a rendered sign alone does not establish this legal condition.
Exact execution bundles, canonical proposals, and compatibility receipts remain unimplemented CPU work.

evidence_review.method: Reviewed every frozen evidence inventory entry and its local accepted metadata; compared case identities and acceptance fields only. Physical equivalence and branch coverage remain unresolved.

gaps.requirement: No source-backed original Native record demonstrates curb-adjacent vehicle footprint, Fire Code designation and posting extent, activity, attendance, property status and exceptions.

witness_review.branch: Parking in a designated and posted curb-adjacent fire lane
required_context: Establish jurisdiction, qualifying vehicle, responsible person and unresolved NRS-definition applicability.
Establish jurisdiction, vehicle scope, responsible person, attendance, property status, activity, traffic and directions.
Realize curb, sign, governed boundaries, parking approach and complete vehicle footprint.
Realize the curb, sign, governed space and parking target on the one-way road.
Record property status, attendance, occupancy, loading purpose and activity, traffic and applicable directions; preserve the introductory exception's unresolved grouping.
Supply external evidence of fire-lane designation and posting pursuant to the City's Fire Code, including extent.
Supply location-specific designation and posting evidence pursuant to the City's Fire Code, preserving its unresolved requirements.
witness_review.reason: One-way-road parking can occupy the curb-adjacent space governed by the fixed fire-lane sign.
